name: Stella Cielo
source:
Aside from the fact that there's a crow that can somehow speak, the boy Ron was living a completely unchanged life. He spent his days simply watching the distant starry sky, letting time pass by.

Then, with a sudden deafening roar, an unknown craft crashed into his backyard. In front of the stunned Ron, a girl who looked like she stepped right out of a picture book appeared with a flourish.

"You are said to be the hero of my star." 

"...ha?!"

Confused beyond belief, Ron was, in a way, kidnapped and taken to a star completely different from Earth.

[Translated from official Website]
translation:
除了有一只会说话的乌鸦这一事实之外，男孩罗恩过着完全没有变化的生活。他的日子就这样静静地看着远处的星空，任由时间流逝。

然后，突然一声震耳欲聋的轰鸣声，一艘不知名的飞船坠入了他的后院。在目瞪口呆的罗恩面前，一个宛如从图画书里走出来的女孩，华丽地出现了。

“据说你是我星辰的英雄。” 

“…哈？！”

罗恩感到难以置信，在某种程度上，他被绑架并带到了一颗与地球完全不同的恒星。
